title: Broken relative link in .github/copilot-instructions.md and stale knip ignoreDependencies entries
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Two small repository-hygiene defects found while auditing the tree.

**1. Broken relative link in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`**

Line 88 reads:

```markdown
- See [.claude/skills/debugging-streamlit/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/debugging-streamlit/SKILL.md) for the full debugging guide.
```

The file lives in `.github/`, so the relative link resolves to `.github/.claude/skills/debugging-streamlit/SKILL.md`, which does not exist. The real file is at the repository root: `.claude/skills/debugging-streamlit/SKILL.md`.

This text is duplicated from `AGENTS.md`, where the same relative link is correct because that file sits at the root — the copy into `.github/` did not adjust the path.

Fix: use `../.claude/skills/debugging-streamlit/SKILL.md` (or a root-absolute link).

**2. Stale `ignoreDependencies` entries in `frontend/knip.json`**

`yarn knip` reports three entries that are no longer needed:

```
Configuration hints (3)
[USER].gl/extensions          knip.json  Remove from ignoreDependencies
[USER].gl/widgets             knip.json  Remove from ignoreDependencies
react-responsive-carousel    knip.json  Remove from ignoreDependencies
```

These suppressions now hide nothing, so keeping them only reduces the value of the check.

Fix: drop the three entries.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Open `.github/copilot-instructions.md` on GitHub and click the link on line 88 — it 404s.
2. Run `yarn knip` in `frontend/` and read the "Configuration hints" section.

### Expected Behavior

- The documentation link resolves to the skill file.
- `yarn knip` reports no configuration hints.

### Current Behavior

- The link 404s.
- Three stale hints are reported on every run.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The link in `.github/copilot-instructions.md` resolves correctly from its own directory.
- [ ] `yarn knip` reports no configuration hints.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.62.0 (`develop`, commit `2ac0d77d3`)
- Python version: 3.13.6
- Operating System: Windows 11
- Browser: n/a

### Additional Information

I checked every relative Markdown link in the repository (171 files) for this class of problem; `.github/copilot-instructions.md:88` is the only genuinely broken one. The other candidates were either illustrative syntax examples in the `developing-with-streamlit` skill docs or a spec referencing a path that was never created.

comments.body:
Two confirmed repo-hygiene bugs, not product regressions.

**1. Broken Copilot link.** `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is generated from root `AGENTS.md` by `scripts/generate_agent_rules.py`, which copies the body verbatim. The debugging-skill link is valid from the repo root but resolves to the non-existent `.github/.claude/skills/debugging-streamlit/SKILL.md` on GitHub. Patching only the generated file will be overwritten on the next `generate_agent_rules.py` run; the durable fix is to rewrite relative links in the generator (or avoid a relative Markdown link in `AGENTS.md`). The same unadjusted path is also copied into `.cursor/rules/overview.mdc`.

**2. Stale Knip ignores.** `frontend/knip.json` still lists `[USER].gl/extensions`, `[USER].gl/widgets`, and `react-responsive-carousel` in `ignoreDependencies`. Those pins remain in `frontend/lib/package.json` (Vite/Deck.gl peers and a Glide Data Grid peer, added in #16593). Knip now reports the ignores as unused configuration hints, so they can be dropped without changing the dependency list.

No duplicate of this report. Closely related prior work: [#16593](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16593) (introduced the Knip ignores).

### Related Issues

No closely related open issues found. The contribution-docs issues below share the area but not the defects:

- [#11740](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11740) — contributor-guide updates (WSL build notes), not agent-rule generation or Knip config.
- [#14097](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/14097) — VS Code debug launch configs; adjacent to the debugging skill the broken link points at, but a different request.

2 has been fixed and keeping 1 as is since this is just a generated file and agents are able to resolve this correctly.
